ops.title: 9.30.0 (2026-07-18, 1fb4d5cd) hand-maintained tables derived: build-time langs.py (29 langs via pygments×ast-grep probe), pyi-driven exports, per-class valid_events, generated skill docs, dedup slate — plus the gotchas that survive
ops.body:
capt-hook 9.30.0 shipped 2026-07-18 (commit 1fb4d5cd, CI green). One wave, five workstreams, all via codex sol lanes with fable orchestration; 17-finding review, 8 fixes accepted.

Durable facts:
- `captain_hook/langs.py` is **generated and gitignored** — regen with `uv run python hatch_build.py`; hatchling build hook covers wheel/sdist/editable. Freshness tests are object-compare (header stamps differ across envs by design). (STALE as of 2026-07-19: `exports.py` was deleted — EXPORTS is an inline literal in `__init__.py` — and the pygments×probe derivation was replaced by upstream-source fetch; see [[doc-tables-derivation-wave-shipped]].)
- ast-grep-py is band-pinned `>=0.44,<0.45` in BOTH build requires and runtime deps — a build env newer than runtime would generate langs the installed parser panics on. Bumping the band = a deliberate maintenance act (regen + retest).
- Accepted coverage tradeoffs (do not "fix"): `*.sc` parses as py (SuperCollider unsupported), `*.eex`/`*.leex` parse as ex (pygments' single Elixir lexer claims them; template misparse FPs are threshold-gated). Zig has no grammar → dropped from the inline-edit nudge.
- Comment scan: 512KB cap (`MAX_COMMENT_SCAN_BYTES`), nested comment kinds pruned (Dart double-count fix), DOC_PREFIXES extended (kotlin/swift/dart/cs/php/scala) — DOC_PREFIXES stays hand-maintained (only rust exposes doc-ness structurally).
- `captain_hook/cli.py` eagerly imports review/cli → anything module-level there rides EVERY hook process. CandidateStatus now lives in leaf `review/status.py`; test_import_surface pins aiosqlite/store absent after `import captain_hook.cli`.
- INLINE_EDIT_NUDGE derives globs from LANG_GLOBS minus `md` (docs-exception policy); the two mechanical regexes in models.py are deliberately DIFFERENT vocabularies (broad haiku-pin vs narrow model-gate) — a past "dedup" of them was a real behavior bug.
- NLP cache keys (ci.yml + docs.yml fragments) embed the resolved oewn version; wn resolves latest at provisioning. docs.yml is generated from `.claude/fragments/` — edit fragments + `cc-guides render`, never the file.
- Multi-bookmark repo now: `ccx vcs ship` needs `--bookmark main`.
- Unshipped review finding on the OTHER session's ae212caf (rm→trash, no root/home guard) → cc-notes note anchored to deletions.py; surfaced to user in the wave report. [[packs-unify-branch-ready]] [[rm-guard-shipped]]
